map.执行后自动生成解读。: Analysis appears after you run the tool.
map.下面的解读由本页面在你浏览器里对刚才的结果做本地分析得出，不上传、不调用额外接口: The analysis below is computed locally in your browser from the result you just got. Nothing is uploaded and no extra requests are made. For troubleshooting reference only, not a substitute for professional judgment.
map.尚未执行，点击上方按钮开始。: Not queried yet. Enter an IP and click "Look up".
map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.输入任意 IPv4/IPv6 查归属：国家、地区、城市、ISP、ASN、域名，先: Look up any IPv4/IPv6 address for country, region, city, ISP, ASN and domain, with format validation before request.
map.先本地校验 IP 格式（IPv4 四段十进制 / IPv6 冒号分组），合法才发: Validates the IP format locally (IPv4 four octets / IPv6 colon groups) before sending any request; primary source ipwho.is falls back to ipapi.co. Enter triggers the query.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「查询」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Look up" above to start.
map.标准 IPv4（如 8.8.8.8）与 IPv6（如 2001:4860:486: Standard IPv4 (e.g. 8.8.8.8) and IPv6 (e.g. 2001:4860:4860::8888). No request is sent for invalid formats.
map.能查内网 IP 吗？: Can I look up private IPs?
map.内网保留地址（如 192.168.1.1）没有公网归属信息，查询结果可能为空。: Private reserved addresses (e.g. 192.168.1.1) have no public geolocation; results may be empty.
map.使用 ipwho.is 与 ipapi.co 公开接口，归属数据库由对方维护。: Public APIs ipwho.is and ipapi.co; their databases maintain the geolocation.
